answer: In the beginning, I spent way too much time deliberating and that caused me to miss a lot of trials because of overthinking. Midway though, I made a pattern with three rules: 1) choose the brightest color, 2) Always choose yellow when it pops up, and 3) never pick the lightest shade (which I think was brown?). With that, I think my partner also started to notice that I was going for my gut impression as well.
My partner would select first, and I would have to guess what she picked. After a few rounds, I learned which color she favoured for each pair.
